authors: Codex: waveforms and integration; Claude Code: voice pool, tattoo routing, lifecycle
format: 44100 Hz mono float PCM, runtime-owned AudioClip
construction: Deterministic filtered noise, swept low-frequency impact bodies, inharmonic metal modes, attack and tail envelopes. Never consumes UnityEngine.Random.
mix: 8 voices; per-cue 55ms cooldown; waveform peak <=0.82; max voice gain 0.135; conservative combined peak bound 0.8856 before device processing. Fixed playback pitch 1.
limits: Synthesized effects rather than recorded foley. Waveform and runtime checks do not establish subjective listening quality. Music, ambient beds, footsteps and final speaker/headphone mix remain unfinished.
